create_graph_with_nodes_and_edges: create a Graph, add Node objects, and connect them with Edge subclasses to build a knowledge graph
add_node_to_graph: add a named Node with a type and optional properties to an existing Graph instance
add_edge_between_nodes: add an Edge between two nodes using a rel_class and optional supporting edges for inference
find_triangle_patterns: find triangle patterns in the graph by specifying two relation types and optional reverse flags
get_connected_nodes_by_relation: get all nodes connected to a given node via a specific relation type using get_connected_nodes
